newsitem.title: USA: Richdale takes stake in Stokely USA.
newsitem.headline: Richdale takes stake in Stokely USA.

text.p: Privately-held National Direct Corp said Monday that its founder, Brad Richdale, has taken a nine percent interest in Stokely USA Inc, a domestic producer of canned vegetables.

The company said Richdale met last week with Stokely president and chief executive officer Steve Theobald and suggested ways for the company, which has lost money in four of its last five fiscal years, to become profitable again.

Richdale, in a statement, said Stokely should create new proprietary signature products with higher margins and develop new health-and-fitness-related products that would be sold though a direct sales force.
"I'm hopeful the board will see the wisdom of my marketing ideas developed from two decades of experience in the field," said Richdale.
National Direct Corp is a marketing company that claims $80 million in annual revenues.
